label: nushi_dragon_0005_friend_02
text: So, rumor has it the False Dragon Titan lurks\nsomewhere in this lake, yeah?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: nushi_dragon_0005_friend_03
text: But not a single person’s ever caught a glimpse\nof it.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: nushi_dragon_0005_friend_04
text:
Must be some kinda truly terrifying beast...\c
But how are we supposed to search for a thing
when we don’t even know what it looks like?\c
Sure would be handy if it just ran around crying
“I’m the Titan!” or something—if only, right![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
